_doc: Frame model (mtah.model): two LightGBM heads on mtah.features. Every value is chosen on external data only (leave-one-match-out over the 5 non-holdout IDSSE matches); nothing is fitted to the target.
_feature_version: Feature-set version of mtah.features the model is trained and run with (recorded in the artefact). 4 = canonical inputs: short ball gaps interpolated, ball and player tracks low-pass filtered, kinematics over 0.3 s baselines, touch thresholds from the half's own quantiles.
_drop_features: Regexes of feature names no head uses. @raw_kinematics = features.RAW_KINEMATICS: player speeds, block velocity and ball velocity changes in absolute m/s; their twins in units of each half's own scale (speeds clipped from below at 1 m/s) stay. The per-half ball-gap descriptors (n_reg_gap*, n_reg_miss) are dropped from every head: they are constants of a half, constants in two of the five training profiles, and outside the training range on the target (label-free drift report); the model reads gap length from the per-frame gap features, which are local.
_head_drop: Features a single head may not split on. The alive/dead head stays simple: no touch or kick timing, no control clocks, no nearest-team dwell, no regime descriptors. Those earn their gain on team identity; on the target a 'long time since the last touch' with the ball in view made an earlier model cut live play (label-free check).
_stride: Uniform rows: every stride-th frame per sequence from a random phase (25 fps frames are near-duplicates; eleven noise draws per match, each at its own phase, add more than denser sampling, and a fold stays within the 8 GB machine).
_stride_near: Dense rows: every stride_near-th frame within near_radius frames of a direct team change or inside a possession shorter than short_poss frames. spellF1 scores possessions, and v1's errors sat there (team accuracy 0.55 within 6 frames of a change, 0.70 within 1 s, 0.98 beyond 3 s). The team head keeps this emphasis; the dead and change heads are weighted back to the frame distribution.
_change_radius: Positive window of the onset hint: a direct team change within this many frames (the decoder snaps to the peak).
_swap_prob: Each training row is exchanged home<->away with this probability (exact feature transform). Prediction averages both orientations, so the output is exactly team-symmetric.
_lgb: Conservative trees: frames of a match are correlated and the model must transfer across matches and to another tracking provider.
_rounds: Fixed boosting rounds per head (no early stopping inside a fold, so out-of-fold predictions never see their own match). v1 (lr 0.05, 400 rounds) was still improving on every held-out curve at its last round.
